Last week the shooting returned to the Gulf. This week the risk spread west. Houthi forces captured Mochaand the strategically placed Mayun, or Perim, Island at Bab al-Mandab, putting fresh pressure on Red Sea routing while Hormuz remains operational but far from normal.
